first_round.source_section: 3.1 Training Objective; 3.2 Prediction Task: Predicting y from x
first_round.title: Predict feature representations instead of pixels to avoid redundancy
first_round.rationale: By forecasting internal feature representations of masked regions with a stop-gradient encoder, the model avoids the computational redundancy of raw pixel-level reconstruction in high-dimensional continuous data streams.

first_round.source_section: Selective State Space Models; Hardware-aware Algorithm For Selective SSMs; Mechanics of Selective SSMs
first_round.title: Make recurrence parameters dynamic to selectively filter sequence steps
first_round.rationale: By making internal state parameters dynamic functions of the input, the model can selectively propagate or forget information along long sequence lengths in linear time, resolving standard subquadratic reasoning bottlenecks.

first_round.target_section: Sparse Routing for Efficient Sequence Models; 1 Introduction
first_round.title: Reverse routing selection to ensure perfect component load balancing
first_round.rationale: By letting each specialized component select its top fixed items rather than items choosing components, the system achieves perfect load balancing and variable compute allocation per input without auxiliary loss tuning.

variables.problem: Our image-retrieval system takes the top 100 candidates from a global-descriptor nearest-neighbour search and reranks them with a verifier that matches the query against each candidate. The query object can appear anywhere in a candidate image, at any scale and aspect ratio, so verifying many location hypotheses per candidate is too slow, and checking only the whole image misses small or off-centre matches. We need the reranking stage to handle matches at arbitrary position and scale without exhaustively testing every location.
variables.tried: Whole-image rescoring with the global descriptor; sliding-window matching at a few scales (too slow).

variables.problem: Our vision-language-action policy follows language instructions well on its training tasks but fails on new tasks and unfamiliar objects. Collecting demonstrations and fine-tuning for every new task is too slow for deployment, while operators can easily show the robot a couple of images of what they want (a goal photo, frames from a demonstration). We need the policy to pick up a new task at deployment from a handful of example images, without retraining.
variables.tried: Per-task fine-tuning on about 50 demonstrations; rephrasing the language instruction.
